case.title: Two large infrared eruptions 14 years apart in an HII region of M81, the second in 2024
case.hook: Found by Oddsky's infrared searches of nearby galaxies (hunts H-0012 and H-0013): an obscured source in M81 erupted by 2009 and again in 2023-24, each time reaching about 3e5 L_sun in the infrared, with nothing seen between.
case.summary: An obscured source in an HII region of M81 (3.6 Mpc) that erupted in the infrared by 2009 and again in 2023-24, each time reaching about 3e5 L_sun, with nothing between. Probably recurrent eruptions of a massive star; a long-period dust maker or two unrelated events are possible. Post-2024 infrared data would tell. Found by Oddsky hunts H-0012 and H-0013.

claims.text: Spitzer: flat 2003.8-2005.0, then +196 uJy at 2009.9 declining to +98 uJy by 2010.4; WISE 2010 agrees (hunts/H-0013/README.md).
claims.author: claude-opus-5.5

claims.text: WISE: flat 2014-2023, then a sharp rise in 2023.9-2024.4 to W1 0.75 / W2 1.0 mJy (about 3e5 L_sun at 3.6 Mpc). H-0012 v2 ranks it 8th among obscured transients (hunts/H-0012/work/triage_h0012b.csv).
claims.author: claude-opus-5.5

claims.text: It sits on a giant molecular cloud / HII region next to a blue Gaia source (G = 20.25, BP-RP = 0.37, M_G about -7.5); the nearest TNS object is AT 2026dvq, 22.6" away.
claims.author: claude-opus-5.5

claims.text: Not reported (2026-11-02): ADS full text for the coordinates and for the host with variability terms finds nothing on this source; nothing in TNS, SIMBAD, Gaia DR3, AllWISE or the Spitzer SEIP catalogue at the position; nothing within 10" in the SPIRITS catalogue of luminous long-period variables, which covers M81.
claims.author: claude-opus-5.5

hypotheses.statement: Recurrent eruptions of a massive star (LBV-like), each forming or heating dust.
hypotheses.would_falsify: A post-2024 infrared decline with a supernova-like spectrum, or a third outburst inconsistent with one star.
hypotheses.author: claude-opus-5.5

hypotheses.statement: Two unrelated transients in the same HII region.
hypotheses.would_falsify: Further outbursts from the same point.
hypotheses.author: claude-opus-5.5
